input.message:
Dear Landlord,

Property: Flat 6, 56 Juniper Mews, Northbridge, ZZ1 0ZZ
Job reference: R/PM024-1

Your tenant reports that the oven is not heating properly: food takes more than twice as long as normal, and items such as nuggets or chips are still uncooked after 1.5 hours. On 5 August we sent the tenant the oven manual and suggested settings. The tenant has tried these and says the oven still doesn't work and hasn't worked properly since they moved in. They have asked for someone to inspect it.

Proposed next step: we send an appliance engineer to inspect and diagnose the fault. We don't have a cost yet. We will send you the engineer's quote for any repair or replacement to approve before any further work is done.

Please reply APPROVE to let us arrange the inspection, or DECLINE if you'd prefer to handle it another way.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance Team, Northbridge Lettings

input.subject: Oven not heating – Flat 6, 56 Juniper Mews (ref R/PM024-1)
input.body:
Hello,

Thank you for trying the settings and letting us know the oven still isn't heating properly at Flat 6, 56 Juniper Mews, Northbridge, ZZ1 0ZZ (ref R/PM024-1).

We have asked the landlord to approve an engineer visit to inspect the oven. We'll be in touch to arrange access as soon as we hear back. We can't confirm a date yet.

Until then, please don't leave the oven running for long periods to try to cook food. If you ever smell gas or burning, or see scorching or sparking, switch the oven off at the wall or isolator if it is safe to do so and contact us straight away. If you smell gas, call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999.

Could you also let us know whether the oven is gas or electric, and the make and model if you can see it (it's usually on a label inside the door or on the frame)? This will help the engineer.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance Team, Northbridge Lettings
